title: Click and collect
description: A Desk board for web orders a store must pick and hand over. A report lists the web orders still to pick (submitted sales orders still to deliver that carry a web order number). On Delivery Note, two fields that can be set after the note is submitted: Handed over (a list column) and Collected by (the name of who took it); the delivery note's history records who ticked it and when. The Delivery Note list also shows the till's own POS Pickup Handed At, in place of % Installed, so an order handed over at the till's pickup board reads as handed over there too. The Delivery Note list filtered on Status To Bill or Completed, Is Return No, % Returned less than 100, Handed over No, POS Pickup Handed At not set, Customer's Purchase Order No set, your store's warehouse and Date on or after the install day is the list of orders waiting for their customer; saved, it keeps every one of those conditions. A workspace, Click and collect, opens the sales orders, the delivery notes and the report, and says how to find the waiting list. A manifest only: nothing leaves your site.

custom_fields.label: Handed over
custom_fields.description: Tick when the customer (or the carrier) has taken the order. The delivery note's history records who ticked it and when.

custom_fields.label: Collected by
custom_fields.description: The name of the person who took the order, as on their ID.

reports.name: PP CCB Web Orders To Pick

data.text: To pick: open Web orders to pick below, then make each order's delivery note. Still to collect: open Delivery notes and filter Status To Bill or Completed, Is Return No, % Returned less than 100, Handed over No, POS Pickup Handed At not set, Customer's Purchase Order No set, your warehouse and Date on or after the install day; save that filter. A filter saved before this update lost Handed over No: set it again and save.
